quotes.title: LTT 1445
quotes.card: The primary LTT 1445 A hosts two exoplanets—one discovered in 2019 that transits the star every 5.36 days, and another found in 2021 that transits the star every 3.12 days, close to a 12:7 resonance.
quotes.introduction: As of October 2022 it is the second closest transiting exoplanet system discovered, with the closest being HD 219134 bc.
